== Versions of 8 November 2026 ==
=== Build notes ===
* [[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata)|Kessel Surveillance System]] now shows the Virtual Block 7.3 sheet text (Spice Mine Administrator); this page shows the Master List text (Moruth Doole). This undoes a 2026-11-08 edit that had put the Moruth Doole text on the plain page.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Intermediate wording, not given an article: the PC website card list (captures 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11, [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html Internet Archive]) read "Opponents Force drains are -1 here. Oncer per turn, if you just lost a card from Reserve Deck, may place a 'spice' card in owners Lost Pile to satisfy 1 additional Force loss. Once per game, may deploy Spice Mine Administrator here." The trigger "if you just lost a card from Reserve Deck" differs from both the sheet and the Master List ("if you are about to lose Force from Reserve Deck"), and the Master List went back to the sheet trigger, so this looks like a website transcription rather than errata. The undated PC Legacy card data has the same trigger with Moruth Doole. Neither is on a dated PC sheet or announcement. If an errata sheet with that trigger turns up, it becomes "Kessel Surveillance System (V) (Errata)" and the Master List text "(Errata 2)".
* The Spice Mine Administrator to Moruth Doole change probably came with the PC's persona changes of 29 January 2013; that announcement's list was not checked for this card. [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 12:56, 8 November 2026 (UTC)
